best_idea: Rewind the struck target, not everyone, to a server-estimated time (latency plus interpolation delay, clamped to a short window), accept the client's claimed time only when it agrees within 0.2 s, and refuse to rewind across dead or teleported records.
decision_why: Keeps the strike-only rewind, the server-estimated target time, the 0.2 s override and the dead and teleport refusals, which fit the server-verified kill rule. Changes: rewind only the struck target (the donor rewinds every player), use a shorter cap (1.0 s is the donor's value; 250 ms is a proposal to test), and count overrides per client. Restricted licence: clean-room, shape only.
acceptance: A server test moves a target 4 units per tick and lands a strike claimed 150 ms in the past on the interpolated position for 150 ms ago; a claim 500 ms in the past is capped to the window (250 ms once ruling 1 is decided); a target that jumps more than the teleport distance between two records is hit at its current position, not a rewound one.
